context.body: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines….

observations.body: David reasons that Saul will eventually take him, moves six hundred men and households to Achish, receives Ziklag, raids, and manages what Achish is told.
